facts.text: Ryan, just breathe and talk to me. Tell me what you're cooking for dinner when we get home.
facts.why: Matt never says this. His real lines to Ryan are about home and who is waiting for her. The dinner line is invented.
facts.fix: Is there somebody down there looking up, thinking about you?

fix_note.text: Is there somebody down there looking up, thinking about you?
